summary: The debug recipe wishes a secret door, moves beside it, and kicks it. At step 23 JavaScript stops in the SDOOR arm before C’s rn2(30); C draws 16, takes the failed-kick path, and calls kick_ouch(). The source owner is dokick.c::kick_nondoor(). Port that whole function and pass dokick()’s avrg_attrib through its production call; this same function also retains explicit refusals for secret corridors, fountains, headstone destruction, trees, and sinks.

source.branch: When the target map square is SDOOR, C evaluates !Levitation && rn2(30) < avrg_attrib. On success it converts and reveals the door, exercises Dexterity, handles trapped/locked/open doormasks, refreshes the glyph, and unblocks vision as needed. Otherwise it calls kick_ouch() and returns ECMD_TIME. This recording reaches the failed-roll arm: at segment 0 step 23 C logs rn2(30)=16 at dokick.c:977 and displays “Ouch! That hurts!”.
callers: C dokick.c::dokick() (1257-1470): computes avrg_attrib from kicking boots or the integer average of current Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution at 1327-1331, then calls kick_nondoor(x, y, avrg_attrib) at 1465-1468.

At the examined commit, js/dokick.js::dokick() computes the same average at 967-972 but calls kick_nondoor(x, y, state) at 1071 without passing it. js/dokick.js::kick_nondoor() then throws at the SDOOR arm, lines 747-751, before the C threshold draw.
dependencies: The successful secret-door arm calls detect.c::cvt_sdoor_to_door(), implemented by js/detect.js::cvt_sdoor_to_door(); it also uses existing exercise(), feel_newsym(), and unblock_point() implementations.
A trapped revealed door calls trap.c::b_trapped("door", FOOT); js/trap.js exports b_trapped(). Soundeffect() is compiled away in the patched tty recorder, so it has no terminal or RNG effect.

The recorded failed-roll path calls dokick.c::kick_ouch(), whose JavaScript helper is already present. This investigation does not certify that helper independently; the current refusal prevents this recording from executing it in JavaScript.

Whole-function source scope also includes the current explicit JavaScript refusals for SCORR, fountains, headstone destruction, trees, and sinks in js/dokick.js::kick_nondoor(); their C branches and callees must be checked while completing the function.
